contract.coordinateConvention: pixel coordinates originate at the top-left; bounds are x/y/width/height
contract.extraction: Nominal 3x3 identities are preserved, but cell bounds are expanded to the nearest measured transparent gutters because generated artwork crosses several mathematical thirds.
contract.grounding: Place each sprite so groundAnchor.normalizedSpriteCenter is the sprite center, then project that anchor onto a locally fitted terrain plane. Never ground from the uncropped atlas cell or the generic image midpoint.

groundAnchor.method: lowest pixel with alpha >= 8; horizontal center of robust 2%-98% lower-quarter footprint

footprint.method: 2%-98% horizontal alpha span over qualified rows in the bottom 25% of occupied height; rows below 5% of the band maximum population are excluded

renderScale.basis: median of current pilot render-height values, bounded by native crop resolution
renderScale.warning: These values control billboard size only. Grounding must use groundAnchor and a locally fitted terrain plane; do not add an arbitrary Y offset.
